Message:
net: ethernet: mtk_wed: introduce WED support for MT7988

Similar to MT7986 and MT7622, enable Wireless Ethernet Ditpatcher for
MT7988 in order to offload traffic forwarded from LAN/WLAN to WLAN/LAN
